cross_cache_check: Legacy B and native-midpoint B are independently inferred caches: bind sealed source identities and allow only recorded FP32-scale numeric deltas. Log per-domain/video maxima; never replace either cache's scores or coordinates. Within-pipeline B->midpoint score/count and reliability preservation remain exact.
frontend: Frozen B24 -> explicit SigmaMidpointHead(1.5)/epoch03 -> unchanged final original OBB+score -> three independent flags.
fitting: Reuse fixed float64 balanced TRAIN logistic simple rules: 3 descriptors, 4 parameters per size/angle, L2=0.1, Newton max100, gradient tolerance1e-8. Standard-scale TRAIN2558 only; no detector/head training.
calibration: One pooled label-free 95% all-frame VAL cutoff per component; ceil(0.95*887)=843, accept entire cutoff ties. Comparison workpoint, not judgement optimum.
center: Retain every valid final detector output; false on missing output. No learned center correctness classifier.
validation: Sealed epoch03 VAL cached replay and fresh full887-frame native VAL: exact flags/four confusion counts, unchanged detector/head states, scores/count, original decoder/coordinates and full-box fallback.
controls: Raw, fixed score, refitted simple. Same-count score and frozen old sigma1 simple rankings on NEW boxes only, per domain/video. No online legacy-policy transfer.
reporting: FA/FR/ED/CR, output-conditional judgement accuracy, acceptance coverage, output coverage, conditional center hit and all-frame center correct coverage. Qualified angle denominator and all-frame online flag coverage separately.
evidence_role: TRAIN in-sample and VAL calibration descriptive; no independent generalization or depth benefit established.
preservation: Old sigma1/epoch23 weights, policy, sources, thresholds and results remain immutable. All stages/log/archive of the new experiment share one work_dirs parent.
